## About the Network

The EMPRESS Research Network is a multicenter, internationally collaborative clinical research network initiated by the Department of Critical Care Medicine, Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences and Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, dedicated to improving the critical care of septic shock. The network's core mission is to conduct high-quality multicenter clinical trials, while also providing methodological support, data governance, and investigator training.


## Studies

<div class="study-card">
<h3>EMPRESS Study<span class="tag">First study</span></h3>
<p><strong>Early Methylene Blue for Mortality Reduction in High-Dose VasoPREssor-Dependent Septic Shock</strong> &mdash; an investigator-initiated, multicenter, open-label, blinded-endpoint randomized controlled trial (566 patients; primary outcome: 28-day all-cause mortality; registration: ChiCTR2500112352).</p>
<p><a class="btn-dl primary" href="studies/empress.html">View study details</a></p>
</div>
